hosting.//: Permanent redirects for the WordPress URLs that tiaracatering.com served before this site replaced it. Without these, every indexed page 404s at cutover. trailingSlash:false normalises /about/ to /about first, so only the extensionless form needs a rule.

redirects.//: The English /menus page is unpublished (TG-1132/TG-1133) and its route prerenders a 404 shell that Hosting would otherwise serve with a 200 (a soft 404). Redirects are evaluated ahead of static content, so this sends the legacy menu traffic above — plus any live inbound link — to the closest English content instead. 302, not 301, because the page is coming back: browsers and Google must not cache this permanently. Delete this rule when app/menus/page.tsx renders again.

headers.//: Pages are requested as extensionless clean URLs (/menus, /ar), so they cannot be matched by an *.html glob. Default everything to revalidate, then let the content-addressed rules below opt back into long caching.
